SOCIAL STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)

   C. Nakuru
